messages:
ken: Heads-up PR 5647 pushed — continuous-batching tweak + kv-cache conflict fix. Running a canary now. Quick bench attached: https://artifacts.redwood-inference/canaries/5647/bench.html
alex: TL;DR from canary: p99 latency +6% on 8k-token longseq, p50 unchanged. mem RSS +120MB on microbatch path.
ria: Can you paste the bench command and raw numbers?
ken: sure:
```bash
./bench --model=redwood-13b --seq=8192 --concurrency=1 --warmups=5 --it=200
```
Output excerpt:
```
latency p50  420ms
latency p95  980ms
latency p99  1380ms (+6.2% vs baseline)
throughput 1.02 tok/ms
rss  9.2GB (+120MB)
```
alex: hm that p99 bump looks like allocator/alloc churn in microbatch path, saw similar in PR 5588.
jessica: @ken can you add perf flamegraphs? If it's allocator heat, we should avoid merging to main. A revert PR should be quick if needed. :thinking_face:
ken: I uploaded flamegraphs and traces: https://artifacts.redwood-inference/canaries/5647/flame-archive.tar.gz — spike around kv cache merge task at step ~150.
ci-bot: Canary run completed — overall checks pass, but perf-alert triggered: p99 > threshold for longseq.
sam: Do we have a SLO rollback window? I can block merge until triage is done.
ken: Please hold merge. I'll instrument allocator and re-run with jemalloc tweaks.
alex: If you're short on time, we can gate the microbatch path behind a feature flag and roll forward the other fixes.
ria: quick Q: Is the mem bump reproducible locally with the docker image? I can try repro.
ken: yes, reproduced with docker: redwood/runtime:pr-5647. Steps are in the PR description.
jessica: I'll give a +1 on the code changes if you add a guard and documented fallback. No +1 on merging to main until perf is cleared.
sam: ack. setting a merge-hold label.
deploy-bot: Merge hold applied by sam.
ken: thanks — re-run scheduled in 30m, will post updated numbers.
alex: ping me once flamegraphs posted, I'll take a look.
(30m later)
ken: re-ran with jemalloc background threads disabled and arena tuning. p99 back to baseline, rss still +60MB. Repro steps and diff in PR comments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5647#issuecomment-12345
ria: nice. can you also add a small unit test for the kv cache race?
ken: added test in the PR and re-ran bench: p99 delta now +0.5%, rss +35MB. attaching artifact: https://artifacts.redwood-inference/canaries/5647/bench-fixed.html
jessica: OK from me to merge to canary branch once CI is green. Please keep the feature flag on in prod for 48h and monitor.
sam: merging hold cleared for canary, hold on main remains. I'll coordinate the canary rollout windows.
alex: :eyes: will monitor traces and latency dashboards during canary.
ken: thanks team — will follow up with 24h summary and perf dashboards.
